# DEGREE 3, DIAMETER 8: 360 VERTICES
# ----------------------------------
# 360 vertices, 540 undirected edges, every vertex of degree 3, every pair of vertices within 8 steps
# of each other.
#
# Voltage lift over G = F_3^2 x| Q_8 (order 72; element (v; q) = the map x -> q x + v) of a 5-vertex
# base graph (link 0 -> 2 with voltage (0; 1); link 0 -> 3 with voltage (0; 1); link 0 -> 4 with
# voltage (0; 1); link 1 -> 4 with voltage (0; 1); link 1 -> 2 with voltage (0; -i); link 1 -> 3 with
# voltage ((0, 1); -j); semi-edge at 2 with voltage ((1, 0); -1); semi-edge at 3 with voltage ((1, 1);
# -1); semi-edge at 4 with voltage ((0, 2); -1)): (u, g) is joined to (v, g a) for every dart u -> v
# with voltage a.
#
# Vertex 72 f + 9 h + 3 v1 + v2 is the pair (f, ((v1, v2); q)), h numbering 1, i, j, k, -1, -i, -j, -k
# from 0.
#
# One edge "u v" per line, vertices numbered 0..359; README.md describes the construction.
